free_tier.stated: No sandbox free tier: SB-Box is available on paid plans only, and a Free account gets 403 on every call that creates or runs a sandbox. The account-level Free plan is 100 credits a day with a lifetime cap, but that plan cannot create or run a sandbox.
free_tier.notes: 100 daily credits on the Free plan expire 24 hours after grant and stop once the lifetime allowance is used; they do not buy SB-Box access.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a sandbox, not an object
per_object_cap.notes: Disk size is 10 to 100 GB; the public base template is 20 GB.

retention.stated: A frozen sandbox keeps its disk until it is killed and its memory snapshot for 14 days of inactivity; sandboxes are frozen when credits run out and kept at most 30 days after that.

egress.terms: Outbound internet is on by default; per-sandbox rules can block internet or allow/deny IP ranges, and port URLs can be gated behind a token. No separate data-out price or allowance is published.

interface_detail: REST API at https://www.genspark.ai/api/sb-box/v1, the gsk CLI, a console, and official Python, TypeScript, Go and Rust SDKs.
tooling: The user installs the gsk CLI or an SDK and logs in with a Genspark account to obtain a gsk- key; sandboxes run on Genspark's infrastructure.
chaining: Sandbox disk snapshots become versioned templates that can be cloned or rolled back, and credits are shared with other Genspark products.

limits.value: 25 credits per vCPU-hour plus 8 credits per GB-hour while running and 0.05 credits per GB-hour disk while it exists
100 daily Free-plan credits with a lifetime cap, expiring 24 hours after grant
memory snapshot kept 14 days; frozen sandboxes kept at most 30 days after credits run out; disk 10 to 100 GB
50 running sandboxes on Plus, 100 on Pro and Team, 1,100 on Enterprise; 5 concurrent template builds

limits_note: A frozen sandbox bills only its disk and does not count against the concurrency cap; credits running out freeze sandboxes rather than killing them immediately.
binding_note: The Free plan cannot create or run a sandbox at all, so the paid credit balance is the first gate; a running sandbox then spends 82 credits an hour at the 2 vCPU/4 GiB base size.

identity_cost.detail: gsk login is a browser login to a Genspark account; the account plans are Free, Plus, Pro, Team and Enterprise. The exact registration form fields were not read.

reliability_note: A sandbox freezes after 10 quiet minutes; its memory snapshot is dropped after 14 days and its disk is frozen but retained while billed. Credits reaching zero freeze running sandboxes and suspend commands with 402 until a top-up.
confidence_note: Rates, plan gate, lifecycle and limits are quoted from Genspark's own billing page and user guide read on 2026-11-25; the signup form itself was not seen.

notes: Hosted full-VM sandboxes billed in Genspark credits: 25 per vCPU-hour, 8 per GB-hour, 0.05 per disk GB-hour. Free accounts cannot create or run one; Plus starts at USD 24.99 a month.

shape.note: public base template is 2 vCPU/4 GB/20 GB; per sandbox up to 8 vCPU, 16 GiB on Pro

extras.billing_model: credit meter on a paid subscription
extras.price_arithmetic: 2 vCPU × 25 + 4 GB × 8 = 82 credits per running hour; disk 20 GB × 0.05 = 1 credit per hour while it exists
